instructions.name: buy
docs: Buy exactly `amount` tokens (partial-filled down to what is left on the curve),
paying at most `max_sol_cost` lamports including fees.

accounts.name: global_volume_accumulator
docs: Optional: pass both accumulators to have this buy count toward volume incentives.

accounts.name: fee_config
docs: Optional: the fees program's tiered schedule (market-cap based). Flat Global fees otherwise.

accounts.name: fee_config
docs: Optional: the fees program's tiered schedule.

instructions.name: buy_exact_sol_in
docs: Spend exactly `sol_in` lamports (before fees) for at least `min_tokens_out` tokens.
If that would overshoot the curve, it partial-fills the remainder and charges only for it.

accounts.name: global_volume_accumulator
docs: Optional: pass both accumulators to have this buy count toward volume incentives.

accounts.name: fee_config
docs: Optional: the fees program's tiered schedule (market-cap based). Flat Global fees otherwise.

accounts.name: fee_config
docs: Optional: the fees program's tiered schedule.

instructions.name: collect_creator_fee
docs: The creator sweeps their vault (all SOL above rent-exemption) to their wallet.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays for the creator's ATA if missing.

instructions.name: create
docs: Launch a coin: new mint (6 decimals), Metaplex metadata, full supply into the curve,
mint authority revoked. Anyone can call; `user` becomes the creator.
`creator`: who earns the creator fee (Pubkey::default() = the launching wallet). May be a
fees-program PDA (social / donation / sharing) so fees accrue there from trade one.

accounts.name: holder_reward_authority
docs: The configured distribution authority (signs and pays tx fees).

instructions.name: migrate
docs: Permissionless: once the curve is complete, move its SOL + remaining tokens into a
fresh AMM pool and burn the LP. Price is continuous by construction when
migration_fee_lamports == 0 (defaults mirror pump.fun's numbers).

instructions.name: sell
docs: Sell exactly `amount` tokens for at least `min_sol_output` lamports after fees.

accounts.name: global_volume_accumulator
docs: Optional: pass both accumulators to have this buy count toward volume incentives.

accounts.name: fee_config
docs: Optional: the fees program's tiered schedule (market-cap based). Flat Global fees otherwise.

accounts.name: fee_config
docs: Optional: the fees program's tiered schedule.

accounts.name: creator
docs: The coin's current creator.

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: MetadataTooLong
errors.msg: Name, symbol or uri too long

errors.name: CurveComplete
errors.msg: Bonding curve is complete; trade on the AMM

errors.name: CurveNotComplete
errors.msg: Bonding curve is not complete yet

errors.name: AntiSnipeCap
errors.msg: Buy exceeds the anti-snipe cap for this slot window

errors.name: WrongQuoteMint
errors.msg: Wrong quote mint for this bonding curve

errors.name: NotHolderRewardCoin
errors.msg: This coin does not route rewards to holders

errors.name: HolderRecipientsMismatch
errors.msg: Amounts and recipient accounts do not match

errors.name: IncentiveTime
errors.msg: Invalid incentive schedule time or day

errors.name: SharingMismatch
errors.msg: Sharing config does not match this coin

fields.name: quote_mint
docs: Pubkey::default() = native SOL curve; otherwise the SPL/Token-2022 quote mint (v2 family).

fields.name: is_holder_reward
docs: If set, `creator` is the ["holder-rewards", mint] PDA and the creator fee is paid out to holders.

fields.name: flat_fees
docs: Used when no tier applies / for foreign pools.

fields.name: fee_tiers
docs: SOL-quoted coins (sorted ascending by threshold).

fields.name: stable_fee_tiers
docs: Coins quoted in a stable mint listed in `stable_mints`.

fields.name: exotic_flat_fees
docs: Any other quote mint (custom pairs).

fields.name: market_cap_lamports_threshold
docs: Market cap (in quote base units, i.e. lamports for SOL) from which this tier applies.

fields.name: holder_reward_enabled
docs: Holder rewards: coins may route the creator fee to holders (distributed by this authority).

fields.name: fee_basis_points
docs: Protocol fee on every trade (bps of the SOL leg).

fields.name: creator_fee_basis_points
docs: Creator fee on every trade (bps of the SOL leg), paid to the coin creator's vault.

fields.name: migration_fee_lamports
docs: Flat SOL fee taken from the curve's reserves at migration.

fields.name: anti_snipe_slots
docs: Buys inside the first N slots after create are capped per transaction.

fields.name: anti_snipe_max_bps
docs: ...to this share of `token_total_supply` (bps).

fields.name: buyback_basis_points
docs: Share of the protocol fee (bps) routed to `buyback_fee_recipient` (the fees program's buyback vault).

fields.name: migration_fee
docs: Flat fee in quote base units taken from the curve at migration.

types.name: SharingConfig
docs: Per-coin creator fee split. When a coin's `creator` is this PDA, its creator fees accrue in the
PDA's creator vault and `distribute_creator_fees` (curve / AMM) pays the shareholders.
